notes: The requested award is the A.A. Degree, but the supplied page (URL and heading 'International Studies: Global Studies (CERT)') prints only the Certificate of Achievement. No A.A. section appears in the text, so no blocks, total, or outcomes are recorded for the A.A. A reviewer should obtain the A.A. page.

For reference, the certificate section prints: Core Requirements (15 units) ANTH 100, ECON C2002, GEOG 105, HIST 275, POLS 210; Division Requirements - Select one Option 9.0, with Option 1 Political-Economic (select three: BA 101, ECON 102 or WGS 206, HIST 246, POLS 220, POLS 230, POLS 240, ECON C2001) and Option 2 Socio-Cultural (select three: ANTH 170, PHIL 200, SOC 215, COMM 110, SOCI C1000, GEOG 102); Total Units 24; one year of foreign language recommended.

The certificate's Program Student Learning Outcomes describe economics (fiscal and monetary policy, market structures), which appear to belong to an Economics program rather than Global Studies; they were not attributed to the A.A.
Code differences between catalog and closed list: catalog prints POLS 210/220/230/240 (closed list POL), SOCI C1000 (closed list SOCIC1000). HUM 100 appears nowhere in the text.
